description: Add a rectangle frame, ellipse, highlighter box, blur (pixelate) or noise (opaque random colors from the area, the safest way to hide sensitive data) over a region. For blur and noise, pixelSize sets the block size; larger is coarser.

pixelSize.description: Blur or noise block size in the units of rect. Defaults to the user’s Blur or Noise tool size.

rect.description: A rectangle (top-left corner plus size). Canvas units, or image pixels with relativeTo.

relativeTo.description: Image id from snipaya_get_canvas. When set, all coordinates in this call are pixels of that image as captured (the same pixels you see in snipaya_render of that image).

style.description: Optional style. Omitted fields use the user’s current tool style. Brand colors: coral #EC534E, papaya #FE9440.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Defaults to the active tab.

name: snipaya_add_shape
title: Add shape
